description: Use first on a new machine, or when up fails for a missing SDK/image: checks/installs the Android SDK pieces crewdroid needs (JDK 17 for sdkmanager, command-line tools, platform-tools, emulator, google_atd images). Dry run by default: returns steps [{step, status: present|missing, downloadBytes}]; yes:true installs and accepts the SDK licences.

images.description: Android API levels of google_atd images, default ["34"]

yes.description: install for real and accept the SDK licences

name: setup
